hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Store visited elements into a lookup collection as you traverse the array.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For each current number x, check if the complement (target minus x) has been observed.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Keep track of the pair yielding the maximum product x * (target - x).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def maxProductPairWithSum(nums: list[int], target: int) -> int:
    seen = set()
    best_product = float('-inf')

    for x in nums:
        comp = target - x
        if comp in seen:
            best_product = max(best_product, x * comp)
        seen.add(x)

    return best_product if best_product != float('-inf') else -1
```

complexity.notes: Single pass complement matching records maximum product.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise nested search takes O(n^2) operations.
